{% set data={} %} {% for item in doc.offer_terms %} {% set data=data.update({item.offer_term:item.value}) %} {% endfor %} {% set ctc_alphanumeric = data.get('CTC','') %} {% set ctc_numeric = ctc_alphanumeric | replace('PA', '') %} {% set ctc_value = ctc_numeric | int %}

This letter is to offer you a position with the {{ doc.company }}. It is with great pleasure that we offer you the position of {{ doc.designation }}. You will be based in Mumbai and report to the {{ doc.custom_reporting_to_name }}. Your place of work will be “{{ data.get("Location",'') }}”. Based on your capabilities and accomplishments, I believe that your talents will not only benefit the {{ doc.company }} but also that our mutual relationship will assist you in reaching your personal and professional goals.

Your detailed compensation plan will be given to you at the time of joining. Your compensation will be Rs. {{ ctc_value }} ({{ frappe.utils.money_in_words(ctc_value) }}) per annum (CTC). Your compensation will also include Insurance (if applicable) Casual Sick and Privilege leave and other benefits as per corporate policy.
{% if letter_head and not no_letterhead -%}
{{ letter_head }}
{%- endif %}

I am anticipating that you will accept this offer by the date {{ frappe.utils.add_to_date(doc.offer_date, days=7) }}. Upon joining, you will be required to sign an “Employment Agreement”. You will also be required to submit the following documents on the date of your reporting:

  • Copy of PAN Card

  • Aadhaar card

  • Two passport-sized photographs

You will be on probation for six months from the date of your joining. Your services will be confirmed in writing after the successful completion of your probation period. The probation period may be extended if your performance does not meet expectations.

Please indicate your acceptance of this offer by signing one copy of this letter in the space provided below. The additional copy is for your files.

{{ doc.applicant_name }} I am eagerly looking forward to having you join our team. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,

For {{ doc.company }}:

{{ doc.custom_reporting_to_name }}
